messages.subject: rhdfs read/write data
parts:
Hi,

I just installed rhdfs on a datanode and now I am trying to read data
from HDFS.

I can see the files by using hdfs.ls("/user/root/data")

I try to retrieve all the files in the /user/root/data folder (ie part-
m-00000, part-m-00001 ...) using x <- hdfs.file("/user/root/data/",
"r")

I get the following error:

Error in .jcall("RJavaTools", "Ljava/lang/Object;", "invokeMethod",
cl, :
java.io.FileNotFoundException: File does not exist: /user/root/data

If I try to retrieve a single file using:
modelfile <- hdfs.file("/user/root/data/part-m-00000", "r")
m <- hdfs.read(modelfile)
model <- unserialize(m)

I get the following error:
Error in unserialize(m) : 'connection' must be a connection

Any help that I can get on both issues would be great.

Rick

messages.author: 1eafd5d24fb29c12
messages.subject: Re: rhdfs read/write data
parts:
Hi,

Sorry to hear you are having problems.  See my comments below

On Monday, April 16, 2012 2:22:19 PM UTC-7, Rick wrote:
Hi,

I just installed rhdfs on a datanode and now I am trying to read data
from HDFS.

I can see the files by using hdfs.ls("/user/root/data")

I try to retrieve all the files in the /user/root/data folder (ie part-
m-00000, part-m-00001 ...) using x <- hdfs.file("/user/root/data/",
"r")

I get the following error:

Error in .jcall("RJavaTools", "Ljava/lang/Object;", "invokeMethod",
cl,  :
  java.io.FileNotFoundException: File does not exist: /user/root/data
>>You can only open a single file at one time.   You cannot open an entire directory of files

If I try to retrieve a single file using:
modelfile <- hdfs.file("/user/root/data/part-m-00000", "r")
m <- hdfs.read(modelfile)
model <- unserialize(m)

I get the following error:
Error in unserialize(m) : 'connection' must be a connection

Unless the file you are trying open is a serialized r object, this is not going to work.  If you have a plain text file try

hdfs.read.text.file(""/user/root/data/part-m-00000")

If it some other type of file, you can get the first 100 raw bytes by

hdfs.read(modelfile,100)


Take a look in the rhdfs/pkg/inst/unitTests directory on github for examples

Hope that helps

Any help that I can get on both issues would be great.

Rick
